back.notes: Initial TUE_P1 room 1219 back-camera seating regions. Calibrated from CP1/CP3/CP5 representative frames; per-room review is required before production use.

zones.label: Back camera rear seating band
zones.notes: Far rows near the whiteboard/door side; excludes the bright empty right wall.

zones.label: Back camera middle-left seating
zones.notes: Left seating cluster with downward-looking students.

zones.label: Back camera middle-center seating
zones.notes: Center desk cluster; light overlap with adjacent zones for edge seats.

zones.label: Back camera right-side seating
zones.notes: Sparse right-side seating while excluding most empty wall/floor.

zones.label: Back camera near-left and center seating
zones.notes: Near rows visible at the lower left/center of the back camera view.

front.notes: Initial TUE_P1 room 1219 front-camera seating regions. The door/wall edge is deliberately limited to avoid teacher/traffic-only areas.

zones.label: Front camera rear seating band
zones.notes: Distant rear rows visible across the upper half of the front view.

zones.label: Front camera middle-left seating
zones.notes: Left-side seating, avoiding the extreme close foreground edge.

zones.label: Front camera middle-center seating
zones.notes: Center desk rows where seated students are most consistent.

zones.label: Front camera right-side seating
zones.notes: Right-side seats and aisle-adjacent desks, excluding the far doorway strip.

zones.label: Front camera near-left and center seating
zones.notes: Near rows and lower-left seats; may include partially occluded heads.
